name: current-base-deterministic-mock-required-Metadata-002
notes: Current-base Metadata-002 covers only the 47 queue rows not already present in existing fixture evidence. The source exercises local result fields, feed/layout DTO construction, enum behavior, and metadata base/value shapes.
salesforceExclusionReason: The current Salesforce compile oracle does not accept the Metadata DTO surface in this lane; this fixture records local deterministic-mock construction and member behavior only and makes no Salesforce compile claim.

source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseDeterministicMockRequiredMetadata002Test { @isTest static void metadata002Witness() { Metadata.DeployProblemType problemType = Metadata.DeployProblemType.Info; System.assertEquals(true, problemType.equals(Metadata.DeployProblemType.Info)); System.assertEquals(false, problemType.equals(Metadata.DeployProblemType.Error)); System.assertEquals(false, problemType.equals(null)); Integer problemHash = problemType.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, problemHash); System.assertEquals(problemHash, problemType.hashCode()); System.assert(problemType.ordinal() >= 0); System.assertEquals(true, Metadata.DeployProblemType.valueOf('Info').equals(problemType)); System.assert(Metadata.DeployProblemType.values().size() > 0); Metadata.DeployStatus deployStatus = Metadata.DeployStatus.Succeeded; System.assert(deployStatus.equals(Metadata.DeployStatus.Succeeded)); System.assert(!deployStatus.equals(Metadata.DeployStatus.Failed)); System.assert(!deployStatus.equals(null)); Integer deployStatusHash = deployStatus.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, deployStatusHash); System.assertEquals(deployStatusHash, deployStatus.hashCode()); System.assert(deployStatus.ordinal() >= 0); System.assertEquals(deployStatus, Metadata.DeployStatus.valueOf('Succeeded')); System.assert(Metadata.DeployStatus.values().size() > 0); Metadata.DeployResult result = new Metadata.DeployResult(); System.assertEquals(null, result.completedDate); System.assertEquals(null, result.createdDate); System.assertEquals(null, result.errorStatusCode); System.assertEquals(null, result.id); System.assertEquals(null, result.lastModifiedDate); System.assertNotEquals(null, result.messages); System.assertEquals(null, result.startDate); Metadata.FeedItemTypeEnum feedItem = Metadata.FeedItemTypeEnum.TextPost; System.assert(feedItem.equals(Metadata.FeedItemTypeEnum.TextPost)); System.assert(!feedItem.equals(Metadata.FeedItemTypeEnum.LinkPost)); System.assert(!feedItem.equals(null)); Integer feedHash = feedItem.hashCode(); System.assertNotEquals(null, feedHash); System.assertEquals(feedHash, feedItem.hashCode()); System.assert(feedItem.ordinal() >= 0); System.assertEquals(feedItem, Metadata.FeedItemTypeEnum.valueOf('TextPost')); System.assert(Metadata.FeedItemTypeEnum.values().size() > 0); Metadata.FeedLayout feedLayout = new Metadata.FeedLayout(); Metadata.FeedLayoutComponent component = new Metadata.FeedLayoutComponent(); Metadata.FeedLayoutFilter filter = new Metadata.FeedLayoutFilter(); System.assertNotEquals(null, feedLayout); System.assertNotEquals(null, component); System.assertNotEquals(null, filter); Metadata.Layout layout = new Metadata.Layout(); Metadata.LayoutColumn column = new Metadata.LayoutColumn(); column.layoutItems = new List<Metadata.LayoutItem>{new Metadata.LayoutItem()}; column.reserved = 'left'; System.assertEquals(1, column.layoutItems.size()); System.assertEquals('left', column.reserved); Metadata.LayoutColumn columnClone = (Metadata.LayoutColumn)column.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(column, columnClone); System.assertEquals('left', columnClone.reserved); Metadata.LayoutHeader header = Metadata.LayoutHeader.PersonalTagging; System.assertEquals(true, header.equals(Metadata.LayoutHeader.valueOf('PersonalTagging'))); System.assertNotEquals(null, header.hashCode()); System.assert(header.ordinal() >= 0); System.assert(Metadata.LayoutHeader.values().size() > 0); System.assertNotEquals(null, layout); Metadata.LayoutSection section = new Metadata.LayoutSection(); System.assertNotEquals(null, section); Metadata.LayoutSectionStyle sectionStyle = Metadata.LayoutSectionStyle.OneColumn; System.assertEquals(true, sectionStyle.equals(Metadata.LayoutSectionStyle.valueOf('OneColumn'))); System.assertNotEquals(null, sectionStyle.hashCode()); System.assert(sectionStyle.ordinal() >= 0); System.assert(Metadata.LayoutSectionStyle.values().size() > 0); Metadata.Metadata baseMetadata = new Metadata.Metadata(); baseMetadata.fullName = 'Fixture.Base'; System.assertEquals('Fixture.Base', baseMetadata.fullName); Metadata.MetadataType metadataType = Metadata.MetadataType.Layout; System.assertEquals(true, metadataType.equals(Metadata.MetadataType.valueOf('Layout'))); System.assertNotEquals(null, metadataType.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, metadataType.ordinal()); System.assert(Metadata.MetadataType.values().size() > 0); Metadata.MetadataValue metadataValue = new Metadata.MetadataValue(); System.assertNotEquals(null, metadataValue.clone()); Metadata.MiniLayout miniLayout = new Metadata.MiniLayout(); miniLayout.fields = new List<String>{'Name'}; miniLayout.relatedLists = new List<Metadata.RelatedListItem>{new Metadata.RelatedListItem()}; System.assertEquals('Name', miniLayout.fields[0]); System.assertEquals(1, miniLayout.relatedLists.size()); Metadata.MiniLayout miniLayoutClone = (Metadata.MiniLayout)miniLayout.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(miniLayout, miniLayoutClone); System.assertEquals('Name', miniLayoutClone.fields[0]); Metadata.OmniInteractionAccessConfig config = new Metadata.OmniInteractionAccessConfig(); System.assertNotEquals(null, config); } }
